notes: Guides written for this entry in this recorded session, in our own words. Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them; where a description leaves the place or trigger open, the guide says so rather than inventing one.
list: Official PlayStation trophy list as published, via Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on all 55 names, descriptions and grades).

sources.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the five roadmap stages in order: story first, then strangers and side missions, then collectibles, then activities, finishing with the money and choice trophies. Clear the 7 missable trophies while the story is still running so no second playthrough is needed.
steps: Follow the five roadmap stages in order, top to bottom.
Clear the 7 missable trophies while the story is still running.
Use the checklist here to track the last few stragglers.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the opening mission Gone Fishing and it pops at the mission-complete screen. It is the first mission of the game, so it will be one of the earliest trophies you earn. No special approach is needed — just play the mission through to its end.
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it pops when the chapter closes. Chapters are the game's big story blocks, so just keep playing the story missions in order. Nothing in Chapter 1 can be missed for this trophy — the chapter itself is the requirement.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's story missions.
The trophy pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 2 and it pops when the chapter closes. The name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Keep playing the story in order; chapter trophies cannot be missed.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's story missions.
The trophy pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 3 and it pops when the chapter closes. By now the map is well opened up, so it is a good moment to start the side content that feeds the stage 2 and 3 trophies — but the chapter trophy itself only needs the story missions done.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's story missions.
The trophy pops when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 4 and it pops when the chapter closes. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so before pushing on, check the missable list — Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Capital Offense and Personal Best all need the story still running.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's story missions.
Before the finale, clear any open missable trophies.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and one of only two golds: finish the final mission and it pops at the credits. Because the finale closes the story, do every missable trophy and every story-adjacent activity before starting it — once the credits roll, partner windows and one-time set pieces are gone. After the finale, free roam stays open for collectibles, activities and cleanup.
steps: Clear the 7 missable trophies before the finale.
Play the final mission to the end.
The gold pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions like this one are single missions inside the chapters, so the trophy pops as soon as that mission is complete. Just play the story in order and it comes on its own.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the heist mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are the big set pieces of the story — follow the planning beats the game gives you, then the heist itself, and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Complete the heist mission to the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, it only asks that the mission itself be completed — no special conditions, no rating requirement. Play it through and the trophy pops.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Headliners. The name is stylised exactly as PlayStation prints it. Play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
steps: Reach Headliners in the story.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission VCIA Takedown. VCIA is the game's Vice City airport, so expect an airport set piece. Complete the mission and the trophy pops — no extra condition beyond finishing it.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. The name suggests a large operation, so expect a longer set piece with several beats. Play it through to the mission-complete screen and the trophy pops.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold and the last trophy before the platinum: reach 100% completion. That means the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles, the activities and the money goals — everything the game counts toward completion. The in-game stats page shows the percentage, so check it as you clean up; the checklist here tracks the trophy side of it. Expect this to pop together with the platinum itself.
steps: Finish the story and all stranger strands.
Complete the collectibles and activities in stages 3 and 4.
Watch the in-game completion percentage climb to 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: The long grind of stage 4: complete 250 stunts. The description does not pin down which moves count as a stunt, so the honest approach is jumps and air time — launch cars and bikes off ramps, jumps and hills in free roam, and let the total climb. Use the PSN counter here to track your count, and fold stunt attempts into normal travel instead of grinding them in one sitting.
steps: Attempt jumps and air time in free roam — ramps, hills and jumps.
Let the total build across normal play; check the counter here.
Keep going until the counter reaches 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity once. The description does not list the activity types, so sample them all early — racing, the Shooting Range, fishing, drone races, arcade games, bowling, robbing, hunting — one attempt at each. Doing this early also unlocks the deeper trophies for the activities you enjoy, and it pops as soon as the last untried type is sampled.
steps: Try one of each activity type: race, range, fishing, drone race, arcade, bowling.
Add robbing, hunting and any other activity the map offers.
The trophy pops once every type has been tried once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the hardest silver in the list. Each challenge has its own gold threshold, so learn one challenge at a time: steady aim, trigger discipline, and the reload rhythm the challenge rewards. The counter here tracks how many of the 42 are gold. Expect this to be one of the last activity trophies you finish.
steps: Work the Shooting Range challenges one at a time.
Learn each challenge's gold threshold and the aim it rewards.
Track golds with the counter until all 42 are done.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. The description does not say how many locations there are, so visit each Top Fun spot on the map and win its drone race — a win at a location you have already won does not add anything. Learn the racing line for each course; the drones handle the same everywhere, so the course is the challenge.
steps: Find each Top Fun location on the map.
Win the drone race at each one.
The trophy pops once every location has a win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different means distinct races, so winning the same race twice only counts once. Vary the race types and locations: street races, off-road, boat and air races if the map offers them. The counter here tracks your distinct wins. Pair this with the drone races and the stunt total to make stage 4 efficient.
steps: Race across different types and locations.
Win each distinct race once — repeats do not count twice.
Track distinct wins with the counter until 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival — find his challenge, out-fish him, and the trophy pops. The description does not say where Cal waits or which challenge it is, so work the fishing spots until his challenge appears, then focus on landing the bigger catch.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Out-fish Cal in the challenge.
The trophy pops on the win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play an arcade cabinet through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you find and finish it. Arcades are scattered around Leonida; one completed game is all this trophy asks.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play its game through to completion.
The trophy pops when the game ends.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy: finish Andy's strand by completing his final mission. Stranger markers only appear once you have been near them, so explore every region and follow Andy's missions as they unlock. The trophy pops when his last mission is complete.
steps: Explore until Andy's stranger marker appears.
Play Andy's missions through to his final one.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy: finish Kenton's strand by completing his final mission. The name hints at boats, so expect water work in his missions. Explore the coast and waterways until his marker appears, then play his strand through to the end.
steps: Explore until Kenton's stranger marker appears.
Play Kenton's missions through to his final one.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy: finish Billy's strand by completing his final mission. The name suggests a rider, so expect bikes and open-road work. Explore until his marker appears, then play his missions through to the final one.
steps: Explore until Billy's stranger marker appears.
Play Billy's missions through to his final one.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the silver that ties stage 2 together. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a final-mission trophy, and Bret has a hunt, so those six strands alone nearly finish this. Explore every region to reveal the markers, then finish strands one by one; the counter here tracks your completed strands.
steps: Explore every region to reveal stranger markers.
Finish the strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
Add Bret's hunt and two more strands to reach 8.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy: finish Randy's strand by completing his final mission. The name suggests moving goods, so expect delivery and supply work in his missions. Explore until his marker appears, then play his strand through to the end.
steps: Explore until Randy's stranger marker appears.
Play Randy's missions through to his final one.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy: finish Tyrone's strand by completing his final mission. The name suggests music or records, so expect his strand to circle that world. Explore until his marker appears, then play his missions through to the final one.
steps: Explore until Tyrone's stranger marker appears.
Play Tyrone's missions through to his final one.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. The description does not say how many spots there are, so work region by region: when you find a spot, meditate there, then move on. Scenic overlooks and quiet corners are the likely places — check each one you pass rather than hunting them all at the end.
steps: Find meditation spots as you explore each region.
Meditate at every spot you find.
The trophy pops once no spot is left unvisited.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a named creature, not just any animal. Bret's strand points you at the hunt; follow his lead, track the animal, and take it down. This strand also counts toward the 8 stranger strands, so do it as part of stage 2.
steps: Find Bret's strand and follow it to the hunt.
Track the unique animal Bret names.
Take it down to complete the hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, houses, and out-of-the-way corners — so pick them up as you travel rather than hunting them all at once. A set completes when every card in it is found; the counter here tracks your completed sets.
steps: Collect cards as you explore each region.
Complete one full set, then a second and a third.
Track completed sets with the counter.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — the photo-spot collectible, one hundred of them across Leonida. Treat it like the other collectibles: work region by region, and snap each spot as you pass it. The counter here tracks your locations, so you always know how many are left.
steps: Find WAiNK spots as you travel each region.
WAiNK It at every spot you find.
Track locations with the counter until 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small goals layered over the activities — race times, shooting scores, stunt counts and more — so they pile up naturally while you work stage 4. The counter here tracks your total; if you are short at the end, look for the easiest uncompleted challenges in the activities you already play.
steps: Play activities in stage 4 and let challenges complete.
Check the counter to see how many are left.
Finish the easiest remaining challenges to reach 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.window: During the story, while your partner is with you. Closes when the story ends — do it before the final mission.
trophies.guide: Missable: while your partner is with you during the story, build a 4-star wanted level together, then lose the cops and escape. Do it before the final mission — once the story ends, the partner window closes. Plan it deliberately: pick a quiet stretch of road, raise the heat to 4 stars, then break line of sight and lay low until the stars clear.
steps: Wait for a moment in the story when your partner is with you.
Build a 4-star wanted level together.
Lose the cops and escape the heat.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.window: During the story, while your partner is with you. Same partner window as Hot Together — closes when the story ends.
trophies.guide: Missable: with your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. The trick is the opposite of Hot Together — here you must KEEP the heat, so rob quickly and move to the next shop before the stars fade. Plan a route past three shops in a row, and do it during the story, before the finale closes the partner window.
steps: Plan a route past three shops in a row.
Rob the first shop with your partner.
Hit the next two back-to-back before the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or encounter 100 distinct vehicles across Leonida. The total climbs on its own as you travel, steal, and test-drive new rides; variety matters, so try cars, bikes, boats and aircraft wherever the map offers them. The counter here tracks your distinct discoveries.
steps: Drive and encounter new vehicles as you travel.
Try different types: cars, bikes, boats, aircraft.
Track distinct discoveries with the counter until 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. The setup matters more than the aim: gather a group of five enemies first — a gang hangout or a wanted-level shootout — then trigger Combat Focus and drop all five before it ends. If the group thins out, back off and try a busier spot.
steps: Find a spot with at least five enemies together.
Trigger Combat Focus with the group in range.
Take down all five before Combat Focus ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport. The description does not pin down what counts as unscheduled, so the plain reading is taking an aircraft and leaving without clearance — get to a plane on the VCIA tarmac in free roam and take off. If that does not pop it, the trigger is one the description leaves open, and the guide will say so.
steps: Go to VCIA in free roam.
Get to an aircraft on the tarmac.
Take off without clearance for an unscheduled departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a quip, not instructions — it names Rhinos, the game's tanks, and nothing else. The trophy almost certainly involves a Rhino: driving one, fighting in one, or surviving in one. The exact trigger is not pinned by the description, so get into a Rhino and use it in combat; this guide will not invent a specific condition the description does not give.
steps: Find a Rhino tank.
Get in and use it — drive it and fight in it.
The trophy pops on whatever tank feat the game counts.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole job: go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, let the heat die, and try again with a slower approach.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and case it first.
Rob it without being seen by staff or cameras.
Leave clean — detection voids the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — the silver robbery trophy. Each vault is a full job: get in, crack the vault, grab the take and get out clean. The escape counts, so plan your exit before you go in. The counter here tracks your completed vaults; five clean escapes and the silver is yours.
steps: Plan a bank vault robbery, exit route included.
Rob the vault and escape clean.
Repeat for five vaults in total.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level that follows. The escape is part of the trophy, so do not stop fighting until the stars are gone.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it and rob the cash.
Escape and lose the wanted level.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every region of the map. The trophy is about coverage, so drive, fly and sail into the corners you never visit: the far beaches, the swamps, the small towns, the mountain roads. The in-game map shows what is still fogged or unvisited; when the last corner is covered, the trophy pops.
steps: Travel to every region of Leonida.
Check the map for corners still unvisited.
Cover the last region to complete the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — one per gang, not one total. The description does not list the gangs, so work through them as you find their operations around Leonida: hit one operation for each gang and the trophy pops. Expect each gang's turf to defend its own operation, so go in ready.
steps: Find the illegal operations run by each gang.
Rob one operation for each gang.
The trophy pops once every gang has been hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the beachfront bar spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view — the trophy is a quiet moment, not a challenge. The ellipsis in the name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find the beachfront cocktail spot.
Order a cocktail and enjoy the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.window: Your first visit to a vehicle showroom in the story. One-time set piece — do it on that first visit, before the story moves on.
trophies.guide: Missable: on your first visit to a vehicle showroom in the story, smash your way out in classic style — drive straight through the glass, the way the old games taught you. It is a one-time set piece on that first visit, so do it then; once the story moves on, the moment is gone.
steps: Reach your first vehicle showroom visit in the story.
Get in a vehicle inside the showroom.
Smash your way out through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The description names the alley but not the exact feat, so the plain reading is to bowl a proper game there — play through a full game at the Kolt & Associates lanes and the trophy should pop on the follow-through. If a full game does not do it, the specific feat is one the description leaves open.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a full game there.
The trophy pops on the follow-through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.window: During the story, while partner activities are available. Play partner content as it comes — do not leave it until after the finale.
trophies.guide: Missable: a partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it names no act, no place, no number — so the honest guidance is to play partner content as it comes during the story: the shared activities, the co-op moments, the things you do together. Do them while the story offers them; after the finale the window is closed and the trigger is gone.
steps: Play partner activities as the story offers them.
Do the shared content together, not solo.
Do not leave partner content until after the finale.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.window: The whole playthrough. A skipped choice cannot be remade, so choose every time the game offers one — it closes at the finale.
trophies.guide: Missable: choices made, for better or worse. Across the whole playthrough the game offers choices — take them, every time, instead of walking past. A skipped choice cannot be remade, and the window closes at the finale, so this trophy is really a habit: whenever the game asks, answer.
steps: Choose every time the game offers a choice.
Never skip a choice prompt.
Keep choosing through the whole playthrough to the finale.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.window: Any retryable mission or challenge — but it must be the immediate retry. If you play clean, do it deliberately early, before the finale.
trophies.guide: Missable: second time's the charm — fail something, then succeed on the immediate retry. Any retryable mission or challenge counts, but it must be the retry right after the failure, not a later attempt. If you play clean, do it deliberately and early: fail a mission on purpose, retry at once, and finish it.
steps: Fail a retryable mission or challenge.
Retry it immediately — the very next attempt.
Succeed on that retry for the trophy.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.window: A one-time sighting somewhere in Leonida. When something strange happens, stay and watch it play out — walking away may lose it.
trophies.guide: Missable: a one-time sighting somewhere in Leonida. The description is a reaction, not directions — something strange happens, once, somewhere in the state. When it happens, stay and watch it play out; walking away may lose it. Explore the odd corners of the map — the swamps, the desert roads, the night sky — and keep your eyes open.
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners, day and night.
When something strange happens, stay and watch.
Do not walk away from a strange sighting.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by — knock people down from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon, like bowling pins. The pun is the instruction: drive past a group, swing the melee weapon from the vehicle, and send them sprawling. One good pass is all it takes.
steps: Find a group of people on foot.
Drive past them with a melee weapon ready.
Strike from the moving vehicle to bowl them over.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from the big scores; launder them through your contacts and the clean money counts toward the $250,000. It accumulates across the playthrough, so keep laundering after every heist and robbery. The counter here tracks your laundered total.
steps: Earn marked bills from heists and robberies.
Launder them through your contacts.
Track the laundered total until $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase counts — clothes, weapons, ammo, food, vehicles, property — so the total climbs on its own as you gear up. If you are short near the end, spend on the big items: vehicles and property close the gap fastest. The counter here tracks your spending.
steps: Buy gear, weapons and supplies as you play.
Spend on vehicles and property for big jumps.
Track spending with the counter until $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages are the property buy of stage 3 — find each one for sale around Leonida and buy it. They also give you somewhere to store the 100 vehicles you are discovering, so buy them as you go and the trophy pops with the last purchase.
steps: Find garage properties for sale around Leonida.
Buy each one as you find it.
The trophy pops with the final purchase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it through the app instead of just driving it away — ten registrations and the trophy pops. It pairs naturally with discovering 100 vehicles, so register the best of what you find.
steps: Find vehicles worth keeping.
Register each one through the Scooter Bros app.
Track registrations with the counter until 10.
